symbols.name: SparseGraph

Algorithms: BFS, multiBFS, Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford, SPFA, 0-1 BFS, topoSort, SCC (Kosaraju + Tarjan), bridges, articulation points, Prim MST, Kruskal MST, Euler path/circuit, connectedComponents, weakConnectedComponents, isBipartite, LCA, treeDiameter, weightedTreeDiameter, negativeCycle, secondBestMST, dfsOrder
